items: Size-curve buys guessed; end-of-season markdowns absorbed the error.
Hero-SKU shortages at flagship doors while slow doors overstocked.
Counterfeits and grey market contested authenticity with no verification path.

blocks.x: Assortment intelligence models curves by door with demand-transfer logic feeding allocation; clienteling copilots surface client history to associates; and a Ledger product-birth-certificate network powers consumer authenticity verification for flagship lines.

The operating cadence, concretely: weeks 1–2 produce the signed baseline: current per SKU-store performance, method note, and a control owner who co-signs every later claim. weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one product line — with evidence to your control owner weekly. Nothing in this topology is accidental: models, agents and rules move through versioned, evaluated releases in A global fashion group, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence.. Nothing in this topology is accidental: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default across the A global fashion group estate, so the question of how we know gets a pointer, not a paragraph.

items: The delta we sign up to is 55% — verified against live data at every gate

At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy on Data, Analytics & Lakehouse programs, which is what makes the reported delta defensible in audit.
